verdict.rationale: Medusa publishes a B2B Recipe and says its framework and modules can support advanced B2B alongside DTC stores, which shows B2B is a documented use case. A 'recipe' framing suggests merchants assemble B2B from modules and customization rather than getting it ready-made. The pack gives only the recipe's title, with no detail on any of the specific capabilities the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of customer-specific price lists, volume/tiered pricing, quote workflows, net-terms invoicing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of B2B use.
